metadata.title: Vintage Soft-Focus Portrait with Overlapping Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A tight, soft-focus facial portrait featuring heavy, overlapping slab-serif display type at the top edge and a diagonal prismatic lens flare.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-key portrait of a person with soft, diffused lighting and a prominent diagonal rainbow-hued light leak. The top of the frame is dominated by large, bold, orange-red slab-serif text where characters physically touch or overlap, underlined by a thin horizontal rule containing secondary metadata.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight facial crop filling the lower two-thirds of the frame
Heavy display type anchored to the top margin
Diagonal prismatic flare cutting across the subject's forehead
Muted, warm skin tones against a dark, indistinct background
coreInvariants: Overlapping character spacing in the primary display text
Soft-focus photographic texture with low micro-contrast
Horizontal rule separating primary and secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait centered horizontally, filling the frame from the bottom to the upper-third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold display text at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold header, follow the diagonal light leak down to the subject's eyes, then rest on the central facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for typography and prismatic rainbow hues in the flare
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation portraiture contrasted with high-saturation, medium-value typography.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to 1970s earth tones and warm reds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with rectangular terminals
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking causing glyphs to overlap
Consistent stroke weight with minimal modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'M' overlap at the base
The 'S' and 'B' touch at their widest curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform slab-serif family used at contrasting scales and weights.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif geometry and 70s feel.
Provides the necessary weight and blocky serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, high-key portrait of a person with 1970s hair, featuring a diagonal rainbow prismatic lens flare across the upper half and a dark, blurry background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold slab-serif uppercase text at the top edge in orange-red with touching/overlapping kerning. Below it, add a thin horizontal bar containing smaller condensed slab-serif text.

verificationChecks: Ensure the primary text characters are touching or overlapping.
Verify the presence of a diagonal prismatic light leak.
Check that the portrait has a soft, diffused, vintage photographic quality.
Confirm the typography is anchored to the top margin.

mustRedesign: Do not use standard default kerning
Ensure the light leak looks organic, not a hard gradient

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and soft focus
avoid: Vector-perfect clean lines in the flare

postGenerationChecks: Is the text color a warm orange-red?
Does the light leak have a prismatic/rainbow effect?
Is the portrait crop tight on the face?
Are the serifs on the display type prominent and blocky?
Is there a horizontal rule separating the text levels?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus vintage portrait with a diagonal light leak and top-aligned, overlapping slab-serif display type.
